import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the supplied sales data and aggregate revenue by region.
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')
revenue_by_region = df.groupby('region')['revenue'].sum()
revenue_by_region.loc['US'] += 5000  # Expected April revenue

fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.bar(revenue_by_region.index, revenue_by_region.values)
ax.set_title('Total Revenue by Region (including expected April US revenue)')
ax.set_xlabel('Region')
ax.set_ylabel('Revenue')
ax.set_ylim(0, max(revenue_by_region.values) * 1.1)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
